name: maclaurin-chapel

building.title: Maclaurin Chapel, University of Auckland
building.note: outline: building 107's outline from the main project's campus.json, in the map's frame; used only to choose the crop box, to pick the building's own points (frame.near_outline) and to draw on the heightmap figure; the frame comes from the LiDAR.

origin.note: the campus origin, as in campus.json; the landmark's local metres = NZTM (EPSG:2193) minus the NZTM of this point, with grid north

lidar.licence: Auckland Part 1 LiDAR (2024), OpenTopography NZ24_Auckland, doi:10.5069/G9HH6H8T: sourced from LINZ and licensed by Regional Software Holdings Limited for re-use under CC BY 4.0

aerial.licence: Auckland Central 0.06 m Urban Aerial Photos (2023): sourced from LINZ and licensed by Auckland Council for re-use under CC BY 4.0

frame.method: LiDAR building points (class 6) within near_outline m of building 107's outline: centre = mean x/y of points higher than tower_above m; axis = principal axis of points between min_above and spine_below m high within spine_radius m of the centre (pointing north-ish, as street_side is west); toStreet = the axis turned 90 deg toward street_side: west-north-west, to Princes Street.

ground_note: provisional: the LiDAR ground along the Princes Street (west-north-west) side of the building; set at the door once the references show it
